title: 'All Thumbs' (1/3)
summaryZh: 本集介紹片語 all thumbs，用來形容一個人笨手笨腳。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Words and Their Stories

sentences.text: And now, words and their stories from VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: 接下來是 VOA 學習英語的「詞語故事」節目。

sentences.text: On this show, we explore words and expressions a little more deeply.
sentences.zh: 在這個節目裡，我們會更深入地探討單字和用語。

sentences.text: We give you synonyms, words that mean close to the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我們會告訴你同義詞，也就是意思很接近的字。

sentences.text: And we use the expressions in a conversation.
sentences.zh: 我們還會把這些用語放進對話裡示範。

sentences.text: Today, we talk about our hands.
sentences.zh: 今天我們要來聊聊我們的手。
更精確地說，是我們的大拇指。

sentences.text: Most of us have one thumb and four fingers on each hand.
sentences.zh: 我們大多數人每隻手都有一根大拇指和四根手指。

sentences.text: Our thumbs let us perform certain tasks.
sentences.zh: 大拇指讓我們能完成某些動作。

sentences.text: But what if all our fingers were replaced with thumbs?
sentences.zh: 但如果我們所有的手指都變成大拇指呢？

sentences.text: Those tasks we normally perform with ease would become much more difficult.
sentences.zh: 那些我們平常輕輕鬆鬆就能做到的事，會變得困難許多。

sentences.text: In fact, we would lose the ability to do many things with our hands.
sentences.zh: 事實上，我們會失去用手做很多事情的能力。

sentences.text: Our movements would become careless and clumsy.
sentences.zh: 我們的動作會變得粗手粗腳、笨拙不靈活。

sentences.text: We would drop things all the time.
sentences.zh: 我們會一直把東西掉在地上。

sentences.text: And that is what the saying, to be all thumbs, means.
sentences.zh: 這就是 all thumbs 這個說法的意思。

sentences.text: If I am all thumbs, I lack grace with my hands.
sentences.zh: 如果說我 all thumbs，就是說我的手不夠靈巧。
